name: Noroi no Kegare Uta: Narumi Tatsuya no Kaikiroku
original_name: 呪いの穢れ唄 鳴海龍也の回奇録
source:
Narumi Tatsuya, a man who has lost all memory, wakes up in a strange house.

Strange phenomena occur. Eerie singing voices coming from inside the house.

Relying on the light of his cell phone, he explores the house where strange phenomena occur one after another and unravel the hidden mystery...

[Taken from Steam]
translation:
丧失了全部记忆的男子鸣海龙也，在一栋陌生的宅邸中醒来。

怪异现象接连不断，屋宅深处隐约传来毛骨悚然的歌声。

仅凭手机屏幕微弱的光亮，他在怪象频发的屋宅内展开探索，一步步解开深藏其中的谜团……

[摘自Steam]
